title: Death of Márcio Santos, TV Integração Presenter
seoTitle: Márcio Santos, MG Rural presenter, dies at 55
subtitle: The 55-year-old journalist who hosted MG Rural passed away in Juiz de Fora
excerpt: Journalist Márcio Santos, host of MG Rural on TV Integração, passed away at 55 in Juiz de Fora after three years of cancer treatment.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Journalist Márcio Santos, presenter of the MG Rural program on TV Integração, passed away this Tuesday (15) in Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, at the age of 55, after three years of cancer treatment. His death was confirmed by the G1 portal and has been a source of mourning and tributes from colleagues and the public who followed his work in the Zona da Mata Mineira region.

What Changed in Your Pocket When Márcio Santos Died

The news of his death came after months of active communication on Instagram, where the journalist shared reflections on life and the importance of a support network for those facing cancer. In June 2025, before starting a new round of chemotherapy, he warned his followers about the need to maintain faith and the fight, in addition to relying on friends and relatives as fundamental support.

Márcio Santos' Legacy at TV Integração

Márcio Santos worked at TV Integração for 15 full years in August, hosting MG Rural, a program that covered agribusiness topics and the reality of Minas Gerais. His presence was marked by credibility, sensitivity, and a familiar voice that helped bridge the gap between those in the fields and those in the cities. Colleagues describe him as someone who inspired daily, not just by what he said, but by how he lived.

Tributes and Impact on Colleagues

  • Fernanda Lília, the station's journalism manager, highlighted that Márcio “loved Minas Gerais, loved his work, and above all, his family.”
  • Daniela Abreu, journalism director, stated that he “is present in our newsroom” and continues to inspire new journalists.
  • Camila Saenz, head of newsroom, recalled his “voice that filled the newsroom, with lightness and the certainty of free laughter.”
  • Hérisder Matias, from InterTV dos Vales, and Cadu Alvim, a Globo reporter, also sent messages of condolence and remembered his importance as a partner and motivator.

Career Start and Professional Trajectory

Márcio Santos began his career at Grupo Sistec in the late 1980s, working as a sports narrator and commentator at Rádio Caratinga 94 FM and TV Sistec. The company expressed its sorrow on a social network, remembering his trajectory, work, and contribution to communication.

What Fans and the Community Remember About Márcio Santos

In addition to his TV work, the journalist participated in educational events; for instance, in 2019, he spoke with 4th-grade elementary school students from Instituto Vianna Júnior about agribusiness and other topics. The local community and followers continue to remember his warm presence and his commitment to information and humanity.

With information from G1, Notícias da TV.
